how.title: Three steps to your first PDF
how.subtitle: From zero to a downloadable PDF URL in minutes. No servers, no browsers, no DevOps tickets.
how.step1Body: Start from a pre-loaded template — invoices, receipts, reports — or upload your own HTML + Handlebars. Need something custom? Request it and we'll build it.
